payload.description: Outcome: chattic.us serves multi-user organizations. People sign in with Google through Cognito, organizations are the unit of enablement and billing, members share channels, bots, and one organization computer, and what a member may approve or see is governed by a delegated authority ceiling modeled on how an office works. Not included: Apple sign-in, domain-verified auto-join, per-member isolation on the shared computer, billing mechanics.
payload.title: Phase 4: Serve organizations with delegated authority
